Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Aditi - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Meenakshi - 41 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Rajesh - 43 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan slips and falls.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan trips over a stone.]

Meenakshi: "One more time!"

[Ishaan hurts his knee.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Yes, of course."

[Ishaan helps Mother get up.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan sneezes loudly.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ishaan coughs.]

Meenakshi (happily): "Good job, Ishaan!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Aditi and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Aditi: "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan plays cricket in the park.]

Ishaan (gently): "Let's see."

[Ishaan swings on the swing.]

Aditi: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan does yoga on a mat.]

Meenakshi: "One more time!"

[Aditi skips rope.]

Ishaan: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Ishaan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Ishaan (surprised): "What happened?"

[Ishaan gulps down a glass of milk.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ishaan irons his school shirt.]

Ishaan (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Ishaan (softly): "What happened?"

[Ishaan sits down on a chair.]

Ishaan: "Really?"

[Ishaan opens the door and goes out.]

Ishaan: "What a day to remember!"
